Fixed. Bug was in `/tmp/wk-rootcause-ggkjbs/repo/src/auth/session.js:3` — comparison operator was `>` instead of `>=`. At the exact moment when `now === expiresAt`, the session should be expired, but `now > expiresAt` only catches strictly later times. Changed to `now >= expiresAt` so it correctly invalidates at the expiry instant.

The centralized `isExpired` function fixes all three call sites: middleware auth check, refresh validation, and session cleanup.
